From 0ae91d8ab70922fb74c22c20bedcb69459579b1c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pavel Begunkov <asml.silence@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Feb 2026 21:18:53 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] io_uring/zcrx: fix page array leak

d9f595b9a65e ("io_uring/zcrx: fix leaking pages on sg init fail") fixed
a page leakage but didn't free the page array, release it as well.

Fixes: b84621d96ee02 ("io_uring/zcrx: allocate sgtable for umem areas")
Signed-off-by: Pavel Begunkov <asml.silence@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

diff --git a/io_uring/zcrx.c b/io_uring/zcrx.c
index b99cf2c6670a..f18c173a7bcb 100644
--- a/io_uring/zcrx.c
+++ b/io_uring/zcrx.c
@@ -197,6 +197,7 @@ static int io_import_umem(struct io_zcrx_ifq *ifq,
 					GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT);
 	if (ret) {
 		unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages);
+		kvfree(pages);
 		return ret;
 	}
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a memory leak in `io_uring/zcrx.c`. When `sg_alloc_table_from_pages` fails, the code already calls `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages)` to release the page references, but it was missing the corresponding deallocation of the dynamically allocated page array (`pages`). The single change adds `kvfree(pages)` immediately after the `unpin_user_pages` call, ensuring both the page references and the page array are freed on error. This completes the partial cleanup introduced in commit `d9f595b9a65e`.
